statements: create table "users" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "name" varchar not null)
create table "assessments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "title" varchar not null)

create table "sessions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "assessment_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer, "parent_id" integer, foreign key("assessment_id") references "assessments"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update cascade, foreign key("parent_id") references "sessions"("id"))

create table "grades" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "session_id" integer not null, "assessment_id" integer not null, "note" varchar, foreign key("session_id", "assessment_id") references "pairs"("a", "b") on delete restrict)
create table "plain" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "commentable_type" varchar, "commentable_id" integer)
create table "kids" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "assessment_id" integer references "assessments" on delete cascade)
